query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='elastisys/compliantkubernetes' AND number=371 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Document long-term retention for logs and backups
data.body:
Many application developers need long-term logs and backups for various compliance reasons. Compliant Kubernetes currently offers short-term logs and backups to cope with security at the platform level.

We determined that offering long-term retention at the platform level runs the risk of GDPR non-compliance. Since both logs and backups may container personal data, retention schemes need to be carefully designed together with application-specific recovery processes. Specifically, the design needs to ensure erased personal data ([Art. 17 GDPR Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-17-gdpr/)) is not accidentally restored.

**Acceptance criteria**

* There is a public doc page with prose and copy-paste-able code snippets explaining how to set up long-term retention for backups and logs on top of Compliant Kubernetes.

data.title: [1] Document long-term retention for logs
data.body:
Many regulations, including Swedish Healthcare, require a minimum of 5 years log retention. 

We determined that offering long-term logs at the platform level runs the risk of GDPR non-compliance. Since logs contain personal data, retention schemes need to be carefully designed together with application-specific recovery processes. Specifically, the design needs to ensure erased personal data ([Art. 17 GDPR Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-17-gdpr/)) is not accidentally restored.

**Acceptance criteria**

* There is a public doc page with prose and copy-paste-able code snippets explaining how to set up long-term logs on top of Compliant Kubernetes.

**Non-goals**

* Please do not focus on backups as part of these issue. Swedish Healthcare regulations leave the question of retention for backups to be determined by the organization based on a risk analysis.
